strings.zh: 你去过城都地区了吗？{NEWLINE}城都愤怒湖边住着一位钓鱼名人。{SCROLL}他的梦想是见到{NEWLINE}世界第一的鲤鱼王。{SCROLL}如果你感兴趣的话,{NEWLINE}就把抓到的鲤鱼王{CLEAR}给他看看吧！{SCROLL}其中或许有{NEWLINE}他一直梦寐以求的鲤鱼王{CLEAR}也说不定哦。
strings.en: Have you been to the Johto region?{NEWLINE}A famous angler lives{CLEAR}by the Lake of Rage there.{SCROLL}His dream is to see the biggest Magikarp{NEWLINE}in the world.{SCROLL}If you’re interested, show him the{NEWLINE}Magikarp you catch!{SCROLL}One of them might just be the Magikarp{NEWLINE}he’s been dreaming of.

strings.zh: 间隙里夹着什么东西。……{SCROLL}是一张长相相似的{NEWLINE}两位钓鱼者的照片。
strings.en: Something is tucked between the{NEWLINE}pages...{SCROLL}It’s a photo of two anglers who look{NEWLINE}alike.
strings.notes: Retranslated from zh (US said "people fishing... They look identical!").

strings.zh: 我是关东钓鱼协会的副会长良智。{SCROLL}看你拿着的那杆钓竿很旧了,{NEWLINE}也该换个好点的钓竿了吧。{CLEAR}如果你能钓上一只墨海马{CLEAR}并拿来给我看一下,{CLEAR}我就送你一根好钓竿喔。
strings.en: I’m Ryochi, vice-president of the Kanto{NEWLINE}Fishing Association.{SCROLL}That rod of yours looks pretty worn.{NEWLINE}Time you got a better one,{CLEAR}don’t you think?{SCROLL}If you can hook a Horsea and bring it to{NEWLINE}show me, I’ll give you a Good Rod.

strings.zh: 你身上带着墨海马吗？{NEWLINE}要给我看看吗……{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: Do you have a Horsea with you?{NEWLINE}Will you show it to me...?{VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 不错不错,{NEWLINE}既然你如约把墨海马给带来了。{CLEAR}那么就请收下这个吧！
strings.en: Very nice! You brought me a Horsea,{NEWLINE}just as promised.{SCROLL}Then please take this!

strings.zh: 使用不同的钓竿,{NEWLINE}钓上来的精灵也会不同。{CLEAR}多钓几次试试看吧。
strings.en: Different rods hook different Pokémon.{NEWLINE}Try fishing a few more times and see!
